features: replaces the node-strip-and-replacement-panel interaction with one left-to-right canvas and permanently expanded stage cards
keeps task input, author profile, research, Writing DNA, Academic DNA, professional context, writing, review, human editing and delivery visible together
renders every optional skill card even when it is not connected and exposes explicit connect/remove controls with an honest not-connected state
supports anchor navigation, Ctrl or Meta wheel zoom, plus/minus/100 percent/fit controls and horizontal canvas scrolling
keeps research evidence, working draft, editor dialogue and final draft together in a permanent artifact reading zone
preserves the existing Bridge handlers for research, DNA corpus/distill/stop, generation, manual save, annotations, editor dialogue, finalize/export and MultiPost delivery
labels the legacy editorial score as an uncalibrated compatibility gate while prioritizing hard blockers and independent review receipts
